scope: Current-source selected copy request and RC/SFUN root-domain slice; whole runtime remains open

matrix.heapIncreaseScope: managed heap/profile limits only; native metadata accounted separately
matrix.copyArbitrationCost: One word per allocated msection, no fixed VM array. If N sections are allocated, storage is N times sizeof WORD; compared with the former array, metadata delta is (N-64) times sizeof WORD. One acquire/release per attempted winner plus header revalidation. Native ordered-word backend loads each inspected header directly; legacy fallback takes an additional gate around its ordinary read to avoid RMW on read-only storage. Same-section requests and reservation critical sections serialize; payload copy remains parallel. Source metadata trailer stays unchanged. Heap/profile limits unchanged; metadata is charged separately, no measured throughput claim
matrix.copyRequestCost: Per VM worker storage sizeof gc_copy_request plus one SIZE_TS; active requests use two CAS and one fetch-clear, source interval checks and one source-charge addition. All MAX_PROCESSORS descriptors are stored, even if W is smaller. No managed heap increase; native metadata and contention charged separately
matrix.rootAdmissionCost: One context pointer per RC allocation and sentinel; one SPINLOCK plus two WORDs per allocated context; short gate operations per RC API and scan, two refcount updates per borrow. Explicit raw-procedure SFUN entry additionally allocates/frees one zero-payload RC block and releases its creator reference; existing C-closure entry borrows its cell and rooted startup allocates no temporary RC block. Writer and borrow gates release before Scheme allocation or native callbacks. Scanner holds gate through mark_array including private arena refill; custom allocators which call RC/ Scheme or wait for the owner are excluded. Native release can wait for this whole root task; its latency is not proven bounded independently of graph/copy cost
